study.question: Does explicitly retaining category-brand pairing within the same historical event improve the current-ad-conditioned readout beyond factorized marginal products, inherited per-field variance, and matched extra capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed starting point: feature-only / pooled / DIN AUC are 0.6050036145 / 0.6102261137 / 0.6133619861. Separate target reads reached 0.6153351064; aligned product values reached 0.6162637997 versus additive 0.6151677274, while crossed semantic operands fell to 0.6151190737. Incumbent diagonal target variance is 0.6165873542 (Logloss 0.1964127870), but its target mean-square control is close at 0.6164331394 and context mean-square is 0.6165090898: distributional evidence remains weak and single-seed. Latest full within-field covariance loses to the exact diagonal replay under both operands: target 0.6163416155 versus 0.6165873542, context 0.6160432792 versus 0.6162324051. This is scientific negative transfer of that implementation, not execution failure; all visible trajectories executed successfully. Its long-history AUC falls from diagonal 0.6178947816 to 0.6175988837 (3,026,583 validation samples; 151,372 positives), while the tiny short-history diagnostic group has only six examples and cannot establish a mechanism. Source inspection shows a distinct unresolved limitation: independently attended means/variances and within-field covariance discard explicit category-brand same-event products. The proposed statistic E_u[c*b] retains joint association that E_u[c]*E_u[b] cannot encode directly. Hypothesis: current-ad operands q_c*q_b can select useful coordinates of this joint statistic beyond the existing branches. This is an empirical implementation hypothesis, not a claim that the incumbent is mathematically incapable of learning any association or that all richer covariance models help.

study.proposed_difference: For each impression compute inherited wc,wb and u=(wc+wb)/2. Let m_c=sum_l u_l*c_l and m_b=sum_l u_l*b_l. Event cell: J=sum_l u_l*(c_l*b_l). Independent cell: M=m_c*m_b, exactly the expectation under independent draws of event positions with marginal u. All * operations are coordinatewise. J-M equals the diagonal cross-field covariance under the SAME u; this contrasts within-event association with a capacity-matched factorized interaction without shuffling batches or histories. Form r=q_c*q_b*J or q_c*q_b*M using either target or masked uniform-history operands. Normalize r to norm([hc,hb]) with zero fallback, project by one new zero-initialized D x D pair_projection, add to the intact incumbent raw summary, then apply the incumbent pooled-norm match. All cells compute J and M, retaining arithmetic cost comparability. Empty histories yield zero pair statistics/summary; singleton J=M up to roundoff. This is an additive new branch; the independent cells control added generic interaction capacity. 42 bounded candidate diagnostics include the exact covariance identity, singleton equivalence, padding/empty behavior, norm preservation, branch removal and operand/statistic switches. Static/syntax checks only are possible locally; numerical finiteness, gradients, throughput and validation metrics require host execution.
predictions: Primary predeclared screen: Delta_T = AUC(event_target)-AUC(independent_target) > 0 and event_target exceeds the incumbent g2-r0009-variance_target (same as g2-r0010-diagonal_target at seed 42). A single positive screen is only provisional; prioritize paired repetitions if both gains exceed 0.0001. Report exact deltas even below this prioritization threshold.

Target-specific claim additionally requires I = Delta_T - [AUC(event_context)-AUC(independent_context)] > 0. Attention and incumbent branches remain target-aware in all four cells; I tests only incremental current-ad operands of the new branch.

Report unweighted Logloss and all host costs alongside AUC. AUC gain with Logloss degradation greater than 0.0001 is a tradeoff requiring repetition, not an unqualified improvement. The comparison isolates matched recipe/data passes; no equal-compute advantage without measured cost evidence.

Algebraic host diagnostics should give J-M equal centered cross-field covariance within floating-point tolerance; singletons have J=M, padding attention is zero, empty summaries/drivers are zero, and nondegenerate drivers/final summaries obey the inherited norm constraints. Expect float32 relative identity error below 1e-4; failures require code/numerical investigation before interpretation.

Compare existing host-defined history-length, hour, behavior-composition, training-frequency, missingness and category-match slices with sample/positive/negative counts. No post-hoc bin changes. Slice effects are exploratory; the first-512 diagnostic sample is heavily long-history dominated and cannot supply population mechanism evidence.
falsifiers: Delta_T <= 0 fails the operational same-event association hypothesis in this implementation; a gain over incumbent without a gain over independent_target is explained by added capacity or generic factorized interaction rather than demonstrated pairing benefit.
I <= 0 fails the extra target-operand-specific association claim even if event products improve both operand settings. Report a generic joint-statistic effect separately.
Zero/unused pair maps or indistinguishable drivers/logits despite nonzero input covariance indicate a failed exploitation mechanism; large frozen-read sensitivity alone does not prove predictive use.

Nonfinite host execution, failed identity/padding/empty/norm checks, or exceeding the host trial cap is an implementation/resource outcome, distinct from a negative scientific result. Do not change protocol or auto-retry an execution of unknown state.
Failure to persist across paired seeds 42/43/44 or intervals consistent with zero prevents repeated-support claims. A failed coordinatewise branch does not refute other event pairing mechanisms.
alternative_explanations: One seed, validation-based search over many historical proposals, end-to-end embeddings/attention adapt differently, and checkpoint selection. No significance or causal population effect from one screen.
Coordinatewise category/brand products assume a learnable common coordinate orientation; two independently learned embedding tables may make this difficult.

Norm matching controls driver scale but not representation direction, degeneracy, gradient conditioning or projected residual scale. Raw statistic contrasts are mathematically clean; downstream normalized contrast is not a literal additive covariance intervention.

All cells retain target-conditioned attention and the inherited target value/variance branches. The context cells remove current-ad operands ONLY from the new branch; they are not globally target-independent models.

Missing target brand zeros the target pair driver, while context may contain a nonzero brand operand. Treat missingness slices and first-512 diagnostics as exploratory, not proof of general target specificity.
Shared attention u changes when trained jointly; first-512 frozen-read interventions are candidate-supplied sensitivity measurements, not separately trained ablations or full-population scores.

Negative results in action partitioning, union reads, crossed projected queries and within-field covariance suggest that extra structure can disrupt an effective simpler readout. A positive outcome may still reflect optimization/regularization rather than recovery of discarded association.

Publisher static user/ad snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, per frozen protocol. Conclusions concern this benchmark and truncated 128-event prefixes; no verified production point-in-time or external-task transfer claim.
